name: Email
shortInfo: Extracts one or more attachments from the email, and uploads it into your destination.
brief: Extracts one or more attachments from the email, and uploads it into your destination.
about: The email connector helps you to move CSV, Excel and JSON file attachments from your email to your data warehouse automatically.
availableData:
[CSV](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/miscellaneous/email/pipelines/csv.html)

This pipeline can be used to transfer data from CSV files into a user determined data warehouse.

[Excel](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/miscellaneous/email/pipelines/excel.html)

This pipeline can be used to transfer data from Excel files into a user determined data warehouse.

[JSON](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/miscellaneous/email/pipelines/json.html)

This pipeline can be used to transfer data from JSON files into a user determined data warehouse.
